displayIdentity.body: Paul refuses those rights in order to proclaim freely. But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void. What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.
displayIdentity.title: Paul refuses those rights in order to proclaim freely
